description: ANA - BHO250 - TRECHO DE DRENAGEM - ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Representação linear unifilar do fluxo d’água principal de um corpo d’água sob a forma de trechos de drenagem provenientes da cartografia. Essa representação é compatível com a codificação de bacias de Otto Pfafstetter. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are ANA, BHO250, TRECHO DE DRENAGEM, Espirito Santo, inlandWaters. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
